# opnsense_kea_dhcpv4_option (Resource)

Custom Kea DHCPv4 options (**Services ▸ Kea DHCP ▸ Kea DHCPv4 ▸ Options**), attached to subnets and reservations through their `options` attribute.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_kea_dhcpv4_option" "ntp" {
  code        = "42"
  encoding    = "ipv4-address"
  data        = "10.0.10.1"
  description = "NTP server"
}

resource "opnsense_kea_dhcpv4_subnet" "lan" {
  subnet  = "10.0.10.0/24"
  options = [opnsense_kea_dhcpv4_option.ntp.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) DHCPv4 option code, e.g. `42`; the GUI lists the known codes with their names.
- `data` (String) Payload to send to a client.
- `description` (String) You must enter a description here. It is used to reference this option inside reservations and subnets.

### Optional

- `encoding` (String) Choose the encoding type. "Hex" supports all encapsulated and structured options generically via payload in hexadecimal byte pairs. One of `hex`, `ipv4-address`, `ipv6-address`, `uint8`, `uint16`, `uint32`, `int32`, `boolean`, `string`, `fqdn`. Defaults to `hex`.
- `force` (Boolean) Always send the option, also when the client does not ask for it in the parameter request list. Defaults to `false`.
- `match_code` (String) Only send the option to clients that sent this option code. Empty to send it to every client. Defaults to ``.
- `match_data` (String) Data to match against the selected DHCP option. Defaults to ``.
- `match_encoding` (String) Encoding used to evaluate the match condition. "Hex" supports all encapsulated and structured options generically via payload in hexadecimal byte pairs. One of `hex`, `ipv4-address`, `ipv6-address`, `uint8`, `uint16`, `uint32`, `int32`, `boolean`, `string`, `fqdn`. Defaults to ``.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the Kea DHCPv4 option.
